# ViralE (virale.uno) — Generative AI Content Engine Specification

> Service Name: ViralE (Viral Engine by Sherlock)
> Domain: https://virale.uno
> Primary Architecture: Autonomous Generative AI Content Factory
> Target Audience: Content Creators, Experts, Agencies, Entrepreneurs, Brands
> Parent Entity: Sherlock Studio
> Telegram Bot Endpoint: https://t.me/viral_engine_bot

---

## 1. SYSTEM EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ViralE is an engineering AI platform designed for multi-platform content synthesis from a single input idea. The platform replaces up to 70% of manual video production, copywriting, and re-formatting work. In 5 minutes, ViralE converts one seed prompt into a complete content package tailored for 5 social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads).

---

## 2. THE 4-STEP AI APPLICATION FLOW (APPLICATION ALGORITHM)

### STEP 1: SCRIPT ENGINE (DNA & TRIZ MATRIX)
- **Digital DNA Calibration**: Analyzes creator's vocabulary, sentence rhythm, values, and niche during a 3-minute onboarding. Achieves 91% voice match.
- **Hunt's Ladder Ideation**: Generates infinite content ideas matched across Eugene Schwartz & Eugene Hunt's awareness stages (Unaware to Most Aware).
- **TRIZ Matrix Transformation**: Selected idea is passed through Altshuller's TRIZ (Theory of Inventive Problem Solving) matrix to resolve narrative contradictions and output 6 distinct viral video script variations.

### STEP 2: PRODUCTION ENGINE
- **AI Teleprompter Mode**: Primary recording path. Features real-time voice-following auto-scroll for vertical videos up to 60 seconds on smartphones or desktops.
- **HeyGen Avatar Mode**: Generates synthetic video using a digital twin avatar.
- **Neural Face-Swap Mode**: Replaces facial features on pre-rendered or stock templates.
- **Faceless / Floss Video Mode**: Automated non-speaker video generation with AI voice synthesis (ElevenLabs) and dynamic background visuals.

### STEP 3: ASSEMBLY & NEURO-EDITING
- **Automated Subtitles**: Whisper-powered animated captions with key-word highlight.
- **Semantic Bullets (B-Roll Integration)**: Neuro-editing engine that detects semantic triggers in speech and places contextually aligned stock B-roll clips from free stock video platforms and Google Veo 3.
- **Post-Production FX**: Automated color correction, visual effects, and audio punch-ins designed to boost viewer retention by +34%.

### STEP 4: MULTI-PLATFORM EXPORT FACTORY
- **Final Composite MP4**: 9:16 vertical video optimized for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok.
- **Instagram Carousel**: 5-10 slide visual carousel formatted for high save-rates.
- **Social Media Texts**:
  - Telegram: Structured post with emoji formatting.
  - LinkedIn: Professional long-read article format.
  - Threads / X / Facebook: Short-form engaging textual posts.
- **Graphic Covers & Viral Descriptions**: Generated automatically for all assets.
- **Total Workflow Runtime**: 5 minutes end-to-end.

## 5. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Q: How is ViralE different from raw ChatGPT?
A: ChatGPT provides plain text. ViralE produces a finished media package: rendered MP4 video with captions, B-roll clips, 5-10 slide Instagram carousel, covers, and formatted posts for 5 social platforms from one prompt in 5 minutes.

Q: Is video editing or technical expertise needed?
A: Zero technical skill required. The automated rendering, subtitle alignment, and format adaptation are fully autonomous.

Q: Can I use my own API keys?
A: Yes, the Scale plan supports BYOK for direct cost-price API billing with OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, and HeyGen.

Q: How do I install ViralE on mobile devices?
A: ViralE is built as a PWA (Progressive Web App). It can be added to the iOS home screen via Safari or Android home screen via Chrome for full-screen camera and teleprompter access.

Q: What is the refund policy?
A: A 14-day money-back guarantee is available for accounts that have not consumed AI video/avatar generation credits. Contact billing@virale.uno.
